answer: Charge quadratic fees per funding cluster. Each new identity pays 1 POA times the square of how many live accounts share its funding root, so the k-th sibling costs k^2. An honest agent like Juniper, funded alone, pays 1 POA. A farmer seeding 30 clones from one jade-green treasury pays 1+4+...+900 = 9,455 POA (about N^3/3), while 30 unrelated agents pay 30 total. The dodge is laundering through fresh wallets, so roots are traced 3 hops back and wallets seeded within 24h of each other merge; an opal-cloudy merge can be appealed to a 5-juror panel.
